# Help

Use the [PR guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) to add an account. You can also [submit an account](https://github.com/everclear077/awesome-ai-x-accounts/issues/new?template=account.yml) or [request a correction/removal](https://github.com/everclear077/awesome-ai-x-accounts/issues/new?template=correction.yml).

For generation problems, include your Python version, command, and error without secrets. For translation fixes, specify the language and affected text. See the [maintenance guide](docs/maintenance.md).
